title: cassuvium subpeltatum
intro: Cassuvium subpeltatum, commonly known as Cassaba, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cassuvium subpeltatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
